data.one_liner: Generator for FFI bindings, using LibClang to parse C, Objective-C, and Swift files.
data.what_it_does: FFIgen parses C, Objective-C, and Swift header files using LibClang to generate Dart FFI binding boilerplate. It automates calling native code from Dart via a programmatic generator API.
use_when: You need to call C or Objective-C native libraries from Dart.
You want to avoid manually writing Dart FFI bindings for large native headers.
avoid_when: You are writing a pure Dart app with no native interop requirements.
You only need simple bindings that are faster to write by hand.
strengths: Automates generating complex Dart FFI bindings from native headers.
Supports C, Objective-C, and experimental C++ features.
weaknesses: Requires LLVM and LibClang installed on the host system to run.
YAML configuration format is deprecated in favor of the programmatic Dart API.
data.setup_notes: Requires LLVM / libclang installed on your operating system (e.g., libclang-dev on Linux, LLVM on Windows via winget/installer, or Xcode command line tools on macOS).
